title: ATF attempt to link guest to the Oklahoma City bombing

tellings.quote: near as I can figure, the ATF was trying to punish me for not cooperating in their investigation by trying to link me to that that bombing.

plain: In 1995, Steve Colbern says, the ATF tried to tie him to the Oklahoma City bombing as punishment for refusing to cooperate with one of its investigations. Colbern is a scientist who studies objects some people believe are alien implants in human bodies. He tells Michels this from his own experience, mentions Timothy McVeigh, and says an author he does not name was writing a book on Oklahoma City. If he is right, a federal agency tried to pin a terrorist attack on a man for not helping it.
